locator.title: Готовитесь к беременности? Узнайте, что нужно учесть
locator.lead: Даем простые советы, как улучшить здоровье, и рассказываем про комплекс Фемибион®
locator.caption: Если любите кофе, то старайтесь пить не больше одной-двух чашек в день — это около 200 мг кофеина, безопасная доза, по мнению специалистов [6]

nearest_text_before.text: Согласно клиническим рекомендациям, нужно отказаться от всех вредных привычек за 3 месяца до зачатия [4]. За это время организм успеет обновиться, и риск осложнений снизится. Исследование показало, что у пар со здоровым образом жизни беременность наступала в 83% случаев, а у пар с вредными привычками — только в 38% [5].

image_reading: A couple is shown from the shoulders down walking hand in hand through sunlit grass.
Their joined hands are central in the frame; the path, grass, and dappled shadows can move naturally.
analysis.article_context: Body image after advice on reducing harmful habits and just before the section on physical activity. It supports a calm, shared healthy routine: starting with manageable everyday movement while preparing for pregnancy.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Preparation for pregnancy can be supported by simple, sustainable healthy habits shared as a couple.
structured_intent.primary_action: The couple walks forward together while holding hands.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The couple is still walking side by side after several steps, with their hands joined.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Their calm, supportive togetherness remains present through the final frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the couple begins walking immediately along the grassy path in a steady, moderate rhythm. Their linked hands make one natural forward-and-back swing with their steps; grass and dappled shadows shift lightly. Keep the camera fixed on the joined hands and torsos. Near the end, they are visibly a few steps farther forward, still walking together with hands joined.
models.positive_prompt: The couple walks forward together at an unhurried pace, their joined hands gently swinging as grass and leaf shadows stir. Fixed camera on their hands; by the last frames they have taken several calm steps while remaining hand in hand.

models.scene_plan: For the five-second shot, the pair moves forward from the start in a continuous relaxed walk. Use a small, smooth forward camera drift motivated by the clasped hands as the focal point. The hands sway gently with the gait while the grass responds lightly to their passage. The motion develops evenly until the final moments, where their continued joined walk clearly remains in progress.
models.positive_prompt: They walk forward together through the grass at a relaxed, steady pace, their clasped hands swinging naturally. A subtle forward camera drift follows the joined hands; in the final frame they are still hand in hand after several calm steps.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, show one focused moment of the couple advancing together at an even, unhurried pace. Keep a fixed camera centered on their linked hands. Their natural hand swing and slight grass movement carry the action through the shot. By the end, they have completed several forward steps and remain visibly connected, still walking side by side.
models.positive_prompt: The couple takes a few relaxed steps forward while holding hands, with their joined hands softly swinging and grass moving in a light breeze. Fixed framing on the hands; the final frame shows them still walking together hand in hand.
